senses.gloss:
ऋत a. [ऋ-क्त]
—1 Proper, right.
—2 Honest, true; सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव Bg. 10. 14; Ms. 8. 82.
—3 Worshipped, respected.
—4 Bright, luminous (दीप्त)
—5 Gone, risen, moved, affected by; सुखेन ऋतः = सुखार्तः ऋते च तृतीयासमासे
 Vārt. on P. VI. 1. 89; so दुःखः˚ काम˚.
ऋत + .{@-तम्@} ind. Rightly, properly.

ऋत + .{@-तम्@} (Not usually found in classical literature)
—1 A fixed or settled rule, law (religious).
—2 Sacred custom, pious action. यस्तनोति सतां सेतुमृतेनामृतयोनिना
 Mb. 12. 47. 49.
—3 Divine law, divine truth.
—4 Absolution. मर्त्यानामृतमिच्छताम् Bhāg. 1. 16. 7.
—5 Water; सत्यं त्वा ऋतेन परिषिञ्चामि.
—6 Truth (in general), right; ऋतं वदिष्यामि T. Up. 1. 1. 1. ऋतानृते
 Ms. 1. 29, 2. 52, 8. 61, 104.
—7 Truth (personified as an object of worship; in later Sanskrit regarded
 as a child of Dharma).
—8 Livelihood by picking or gleaning grains in a field (as opposed to
 the cultivation of ground); ऋतमुञ्च्छशिलं वृत्तम् Ms. 4. 4.
—9 The fruit of an action; एकं चक्रं वर्तते द्वादशारं षण्णाभिमेकाक्षमृतस्य
 धारणम् Mb. 1. 3. 62.
—10 Agreeable speech; ऋतं च सूनृता वाणी कविभिः परिकीर्तिता Bhāg. 11. 19. 38.
—11 N. of an Āditya.
—12 The Supreme Spirit. (In the Vedas ऋत is usually interpreted by
 Sāyaṇa to mean ‘water’, ‘sun’ or ‘sacrifice’, where European scholars
 take it in the sense of ‘divine truth’, ‘faith’ &c.).
.━{@Comp.@}: ऋतजा, ऋतजात, ऋतजातसत्य, ऋतजित्, ऋतज्ञा, ऋतद्युम्न, ऋतधामन्, ऋतधीति, ऋतध्वजः, ऋतनी, ऋतपर्णः, ऋतपेयः, ऋतपेशस्, ऋतप्सुः, ऋतयुक्तिः, ऋतयुज्, ऋतवाकः, ऋतसद्, ऋतसदनम्, ऋतनी, ऋतसाप्, ऋतसामन्, ऋतस्था

ऋत + -जा, -जात a. Ved.
—1 of a true nature, sprung from sacred truth; अब्जा गोजा ऋतजा अद्रिजा
 ऋतम् Rv. 4. 40. 5.
—2 Well-made, excellent; Rv. 3. 58. 8.

ऋत + -जा, -जात a. Ved.
—1 of a true nature, sprung from sacred truth; अब्जा गोजा ऋतजा अद्रिजा
 ऋतम् Rv. 4. 40. 5.
—2 Well-made, excellent; Rv. 3. 58. 8.
ऋत + -जातसत्य a. (Sāy.) born for the sake of sacrifice and having true result.
ऋत + -जित् a. Ved. gaining the right; Vāj. 17. 83.
ऋत + -ज्ञा a. (Sāy.) knowing the sacrifice, familar with the sacred law.
ऋत + -द्युम्न a. shining with truth; Rv. 9. 113. 4.

ऋत + -धामन् a.
—1 of a true or pure nature.
—2 having an imperishable place. ━m. N. of Viṣṇu.
ऋत + -धीति a. Ved. of true disposition; or receiving true praise.
ऋत + -ध्वजः N. of Śiva.
ऋत + -नी a. leading in the right way; Rv. 2. 27. 12.
ऋत + -सदनम्, -नी the right or usual alter.
ऋत + -पर्णः = ऋतुपर्णः q. v.
ऋत + -पेयः a sacrifice lasting one day.

ऋत + -पेशस् a. Ved. having a perfect shape; Rv. 5. 66. 1. ━m.
 one whose form consists of water; i. e. Varuṇa.

ऋत + -प्सुः
—1 a god who consumes sacrificial food; Rv. 1. 180. 3.
—2 one whose form is truth.
ऋत + -युक्तिः f. true application of a hymn; Rv. 10. 61. 10.
ऋत + -युज् a. going to sacrifice.
ऋत + -वाकः Ved. true speech; Rv. 9. 113. 2.
ऋत + -सद् a. dwelling in the sacrifice or truth; Rv. 4. 40. 5. ━m. fire.
ऋत + -सदनम्, -नी the right or usual alter.
ऋत + -साप् a. pervading truth; steady in religious belief.
ऋत + -सामन् n. N. of a Sāman; Ārṣeya Br.
ऋत + -स्था a. standing right; स हि दिवः स पृथिव्या ऋतस्था. Av. 4. 1. 4.
ऋतंभरः God, upholder of truth. ऋतंभरध्याननिवारिताघः Bhāg. 6. 13. 17.
ऋतंभरः + .{@-रा@} Intellect (Pātañjala Yogadarśana 1. 47).
ऋतयति To desire sacrifice; Rv. 8. 3. 14.
ऋतया ind. Through desire of reward; धियं वनेम ऋतया सपन्तः Rv. 2. 11. 12.
ऋतस्पतिः Lord of sacrifices or of divine truth.

ऋतावन् a. Ved.
—1 Bestowing food; ऋतावरनं मघवानमीमहे Mbh. on P. V. 2. 109.
—2 Possessed of sacrifice.
—3 Of true nature or character; according to fixed order, pious.
ऋतावृध् a. Increaser of sacrifice, water, or of truth; holy-minded (?).
ऋत(ता)यु a. Desirous of sacrifice; त्वं न इन्द्र ऋतयुः Rv. 8. 70. 10.
ऋत(ता)यु a. Desirous of sacrifice; त्वं न इन्द्र ऋतयुः Rv. 8. 70. 10.

ऋतव्य a.
—1 Seasonable, relating to the season.
—2 Devoted to or worshipping the season (as divinities).
